content.specificationName: Deterministic Container Testing with Output-Based Validation in Kubectx Sandbox
otherSpecifications: Activity Lifecycle Dynamic Creation Boredom Evolution
Activity Template Flow via MCP Backend

conflicts.description: Cross-vessel harness (223 lines) has duplicate HTTP client, validation logic, impulse loading that unified-output-validator.py now provides. Deterministic Container Testing spec creates unified-output-validator.py to consolidate 100+ harnesses, but cross-vessel harness not yet migrated.
conflicts.resolution: Migrate cross-vessel-type-preservation-harness.py to use unified-output-validator.py. Replace custom HTTP client with OutputComparator.assertJsonFieldEquals(), load expected outputs from impulses instead of hardcoding.
conflicts.blockedBy: Cross-vessel validation currently BLOCKED due to API bug (impulse already exists errors), cannot test migration until API fixed

conflicts.description: Deterministic Container Testing spec aims to consolidate 456 validation harnesses into single unified-output-validator.py framework. Only 2 of 456 harnesses migrated so far (0.4% complete). Each existing harness has duplicate HTTP clients, kubectl wrappers, assertion logic.
conflicts.resolution: Phase migration: (1) Create unified-output-validator.py (DONE), (2) Migrate high-priority harnesses (cross-vessel, e2e-activity-lifecycle, rpc-api-infrastructure), (3) Deprecate old harnesses, (4) Enforce unified validator for new specs
conflicts.estimate: 454 harnesses remaining, ~2-3 harnesses/day migration rate = 6-9 months for full consolidation

conflicts.description: Deterministic Container Testing stores expected outputs as impulses (validation-deterministic-container-testing-case-N). Clean Environment spec validates impulse management tools exist but doesn't use impulse-based expected outputs for validation. Inconsistent pattern.
conflicts.resolution: Adopt impulse-based expected outputs as standard across ALL validation harnesses. Update Clean Environment and other specs to store expected outputs as impulses, not hardcoded in harness files.
conflicts.benefit: Enables validation to run without LLM (historical impulse comparison), reduces harness complexity, centralizes expected output management

conflicts.description: Deterministic Container Testing enforces docker-desktop kubectx for all validation (sandbox isolation). Existing validation harnesses (cross-vessel, e2e-activity-lifecycle, rpc-api-infrastructure) don't check kubectx before running, risk of running tests against production.
conflicts.resolution: Add kubectx check to ALL validation harnesses: `kubectl config current-context === 'docker-desktop' || exit 1`. Create deploy-to-sandbox.sh (pending from enforcement phase) to standardize sandbox deployment.
conflicts.criticalPath: deploy-to-sandbox.sh creation (Priority 4 from enforcement) blocks full sandbox isolation

conflicts.spec2: Dashboard build-deploy-validate, Activity Template MCP Backend
conflicts.description: build-container.sh created for unified builds (metabob-rpc-api, metabob-cli, metabob-opencode). Existing specs use: build-and-deploy-devbob-k8s.sh (inline Dockerfile), build-devbob.sh (Slack package), repos/metabob-rpc-api/docker/build.sh. No migration to unified script yet.
conflicts.resolution: Replace all custom build scripts with build-container.sh. Update deployment specs to call scripts/build-container.sh instead of repo-specific build scripts.
conflicts.impact: Eliminates 3-5 duplicate build scripts, standardizes tagging (test-${timestamp}), enables automated build-deploy-validate workflow

conflicts.spec2: Activity Lifecycle, Activity Recommendation Learning Loop
conflicts.description: Deterministic Container Testing validates 6 deterministic comparison types (===, !==, >, <, includes, regex). Some existing harnesses still use LLM-dependent validation ('check if data looks reasonable', 'verify deployment seems healthy').
conflicts.resolution: Audit all 456 harnesses for LLM-dependent assertions. Replace vague checks with deterministic OutputComparator methods. Enforce zero LLM dependency in validation.
conflicts.note: Low severity because most harnesses already use deterministic checks (HTTP status codes, JSON field equality), but some edge cases remain

summary.overallAssessment: Deterministic Container Testing spec is well-aligned with system goals. Main challenges are: (1) Cross-vessel API bug blocking migration validation, (2) Massive scope (456 harnesses to consolidate), (3) Pending deploy-to-sandbox.sh creation. No contradictory requirements found. Spec complements other validation efforts.
